tool_args.rationale: The long-horizon observations show the predicted reversal and span the slow timescale. Fit all five parameters numerically to the eight observations and test the specified sink-coupled law on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot response changes strongly with sink gradient, and the recalled sink-coupled mechanism accounts for that dependence.
The three long-horizon observations plus five pilot rows constrain the five-parameter candidate; fresh confirmation is more informative now.
The observed sink-gradient dependence is absent from that model.
